scopeRule.name: VIEW_FORMAT_DOES_NOT_INHERIT_CONTENT_CATEGORY
scopeRule.definition: A control that changes the representation of the currently open document (e.g. BRF/Braille) does not itself become help merely because the document is explanatory. This is treated consistently with display/font/view-format controls. Genuine separate explanation/instruction destinations remain help.
scopeRule.basis: The fixed collection contract defines help as explanation/instructions and separately rejects display/environment structural controls. Original handler names and presentation context show a format conversion/viewer control.

preservation: Original blind-v9 annotation/HTML/observation/supporting files and its freeze manifest remain byte-identical and read-only. v2 changes are limited to the listed three accessible names, one independently adjudicated scope judgment and version/fixture reference provenance.
